name: io.github.aswanisahoo/climate-ipcc-rag
title: IPCC AR6 Climate Retrieval
description: Search IPCC AR6 WG1 and answer with page-level citations, or refuse when unsupported.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AI Studio API key. Either this or the Vertex variables must be set: retrieval is hybrid, so the dense half embeds every query.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to authenticate through Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials instead of an API key.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud project id. Required when GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI is true.
